description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for six different models, namely Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 3 to 3000, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot displays six lines, each representing a different model: Base (black, circle marker, solid line), FT (blue, triangle marker, solid line), IKE (red, triangle marker, solid line), MEND (brown, diamond marker, solid line), and MEMIT (green, square marker, solid line). The Base line starts at around 61% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to approximately 69% at 3000. The FT line begins at around 61% and rises to about 71% at 3000. The IKE line starts at roughly 65% and reaches around 72% at 3000. The MEND line begins at approximately 69% and increases to about 78% at 3000. The MEMIT line starts at around 74% and rises to approximately 84% at 3000. All lines exhibit a generally increasing trend as Co-occurrence Number increases.
